北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -8℃，记得多穿保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and cold, feels like -8℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温 15℃。注意湿度高，体感舒适。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast with 15℃. High humidity, but feels comfortable.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 11℃。湿度大，出门带伞，小心潮湿哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels like 11℃ with high humidity. Remember an umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 24℃。享受这温暖的好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and 24℃. Enjoy this lovely warm weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光灿烂 24℃，微风轻拂。户外活动很惬意哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny 24℃ with a gentle breeze. Perfect for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾，能见度低。出门慢行，注意交通安全！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy with low visibility. Drive slowly and stay safe!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雾蒙蒙，体感 6℃。风力 3级，出门保暖防雾哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy, feels like 6℃ with a 3-level breeze. Stay warm and watch out for fog.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温 14℃。体感舒适，记得添减衣物。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with 14℃. Feels comfortable, adjust your clothes as needed.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有霾，体感 5℃。湿度大，注意防护和保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has haze, feels like 5℃. High humidity, take precautions and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 0℃。寒意渐浓，记得多穿点哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels like 0℃. It's getting cold, remember to bundle up!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温 16℃。体感舒适，但注意防护。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, 16℃. Feels comfortable, but take precautions.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴冷，体感 -25℃！外出务必全副武装，注意防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and frigid, feels like -25℃! Bundle up completely when going out!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -20℃。风力 3级，保暖是关键，小心着凉！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like -20℃. It's windy, staying warm is key, avoid catching a cold!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好 16℃，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny 16℃, feels like 10℃. Big temperature difference, add clothes.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阳光明媚 21℃，体感温暖。享受这宜人的好天气吧！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and bright 21℃, feels warm. Enjoy this pleasant weather!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感 -3℃。湿度大，出门注意防潮保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast and cold, feels like -3℃. High humidity, stay dry and warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -14℃。风力 2级，注意防风保暖哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and cold, feels like -14℃. Gentle wind, stay warm and sheltered!
